name: Dr. Jonathan M. Harrington
title: MD, FACC, FSCAI
bio: Dr. Jonathan M. Harrington is a board-certified interventional cardiologist with over two decades of dedicated experience in diagnosing and treating complex cardiovascular conditions. He completed his fellowship training at Johns Hopkins Hospital and has since built a reputation for combining cutting-edge interventional techniques with deeply personalized patient care.
bioExtended: Dr. Harrington specializes in minimally invasive cardiac procedures, including coronary angioplasty, stent placement, and transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR). His philosophy centers on empowering patients through education, early prevention, and the most advanced treatment available. He is an active researcher and has published over 40 peer-reviewed articles in leading cardiovascular journals.
certifications: American Board of Internal Medicine – Cardiovascular Disease
American Board of Internal Medicine – Interventional Cardiology
Fellow, Society for Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions (FSCAI)
